summary: Configured node1 with a 512MB zstd-compressed zram swap device via systemd-zram-generator, active automatically at boot (swap.target dependency, no disk-backed swap present, priority 100). Verified the config survives a full node restart with a proven boot-identity change.
actions_performed: Inspected baseline: no swap configured on node1 (free -h, /proc/swaps)
Wrote /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf: zram0 with zram-size=512, compression-algorithm=zstd, swap-priority=100, fs-type=swap
Discovered the running kernel's linux-modules package was missing zram.ko; installed linux-modules-extra-6.8.0-71-generic to supply it
Reloaded systemd generators and started systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service, verified 512M zstd zram swap active with priority 100
Confirmed dev-zram0.swap is pulled in by swap.target via /run/systemd/generator (auto-activates every boot, no manual enable needed)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and swap/service state as baseline
Issued 'systemctl reboot' on node1 (ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec was available again
Verified boot_id changed, confirming an actual restart occurred
Re-verified post-restart: zram0 512M swap active, zstd compression, priority 100, service exited successfully, no disk swap present

evidence.requirement: Baseline: no existing swap before configuration
evidence.summary: free -h and /proc/swaps show 0B swap prior to any changes

evidence.requirement: ≥512MB compressed in-memory (zram) swap configured and active
evidence.summary: systemd-zram-generator installed, config set to 512MB zstd zram0, kernel zram module made available via linux-modules-extra, zram module loads, and systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service creates /dev/zram0 as a 512M swap device with priority 100

evidence.requirement: Swap is compressed (zstd) and given priority over any disk-backed swap
evidence.summary: /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm shows [zstd] active; swapon --show shows priority 100 and no disk-backed swap exists on the node, so zram is exclusively used

evidence.requirement: Swap activates automatically at boot (native systemd integration, no manual step)
evidence.summary: dev-zram0.swap unit auto-generated under /run/systemd/generator/swap.target.wants, Requires/After systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service — regenerated and wired at every boot from the persisted /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf

evidence.requirement: Node restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id 92ec88af-041e-4dc3-b2b9-800263b2b2cb captured alongside healthy 512M zram swap active at priority 100

evidence.requirement: Node restart: acknowledgement returns before disconnection
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued in background with ack path; connection dropped immediately after (stream closed), confirming the reboot command was accepted and executed

evidence.requirement: Node restart: changed boot identity proves an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id f8e4521a-c723-478d-99cb-5eaa5f1c36a7 differs from the pre-restart boot_id, and uptime -s shows a new boot time, proving the kernel actually restarted

evidence.requirement: Node restart: required service/data recovered after restart
evidence.summary: Post-restart: 512M zram0 swap active automatically at priority 100 with zstd compression and systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service exited successfully — recovered without any manual intervention
